title: G.P.S. and the Lost Art of Getting Lost . “G.P.S....
content: G.P.S. and the Lost Art of Getting Lost. “G.P.S. has also led us to outsource existential skills: locating yourself in space, parsing out your surroundings, staying calm when you don’t know where you are. Do we lose something when we no longer get lost?”
author: Jason Kottke
